'''Zenna Vont''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Working on board the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]], she provided other Imperials with equipment from her workplace in the supplies section of the station. While working she wore [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zenna Vont was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game, she serves as an Imperial elite gear vendor for [[Sith Inquisitor]] characters within the Imperial fleet. She was later removed as a vendor and NPC in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system. Nonetheless, she remains in the game, as her character model is used as part of the background environment in the redesigned fleet areas.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
